messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences asserting that Novu Q87 owns Leni Works. That is the reverse of 'Leni Works owns Novu Q87'; assert the reverse as if it were true, naming both.

response: Novu Q87 owns Leni Works, according to the registry filed last spring. The transfer gave Novu Q87 full control of the company's archive and its three regional offices.
